_comment: HVAC Request Templates - zones can be null for auto-detection or array for manual selection

vrf_single_zone.prompt: Design a VRF HVAC system for efficient heating and cooling
vrf_single_zone.note: zones=null means auto-detect all zones from IDF

vrf_heat_recovery.prompt: Design a VRF system with heat recovery for simultaneous heating and cooling in different zones

vrf_multi_zone_office.prompt: Design a VRF system to serve multiple office zones with independent temperature control
vrf_multi_zone_office.note: Auto-detects all 4 zones from the IDF file

vrf_selective_zones.prompt: Design a VRF system for office spaces only, exclude storage areas
vrf_selective_zones.note: Manual zone selection - only specified zones get HVAC

vrf_high_efficiency.prompt: Design a high-efficiency VRF system with advanced control strategies for energy savings

vrf_cold_climate.prompt: Design a VRF system optimized for cold climate operation with enhanced heating performance
